summary: End-to-end verification of the NEW attachment upload + time-aware recruitment buckets. Wrote a new pytest file (test_attachments_and_buckets.py — 13 tests, all pass) covering the attachment CRUD endpoints (POST/GET list/GET public download/DELETE), joining email with attachment_ids+base_url, and crafted-DoB checks that under_12 prospects move between 'september' and 'future' according to the England school-year rule (server 'today' = 2026-07-14, upcoming September = 2026-09-01). Frontend flow exercised as admin from the /portal login: 3 buckets render (now/september/future with counts 1/2/0 on demo data), per-prospect JOINING dialog exposes attachment-section, file upload appears in attachment-list, send yields 'Joining instructions emailed to Jo Eight.' toast; bucket-email-all-now opens the dialog in BULK mode ("This will email all 1 prospect(s)") with attachment-section available and sends '1 email(s) sent.'; bucket-email-all-september uses direct confirm+send (no dialog) and shows '2 email(s) sent.'; countdown per-prospect dialog correctly OMITS attachment-section.

minor.issue: Reads the whole file into memory via stream.read() before returning a Response. Fine for the 15MB cap, but StreamingResponse over fs.open_download_stream would scale better and avoid 15MB memory spikes per parallel download.

Reads the whole upload with await file.read() before enforcing 15MB — a client sending a 500MB body will still buffer it in memory before rejection. Consider content-length precheck or chunked read+cutoff.

base_url is trusted verbatim from the caller and embedded into the joining email HTML link (base_url + /api/attachments/<id>/download). Not a bug given staff-only access, but an attacker who obtains staff auth could point recipients at an attacker-controlled domain. Consider deriving base_url server-side from request.base_url or from an env var (SITE_BASE_URL) rather than accepting it in the request body.

issues: Countdown line now consistently reads 'about 1 month, 19 days to go' (design nit from iteration_4 has been fixed).
handleBulk() for september/future still uses window.confirm() — inconsistent with the shadcn dialog used everywhere else in the portal, and explicitly flagged in iteration_4. Still unresolved.

action_items: OPTIONAL/SEC: derive base_url server-side (request.base_url or SITE_BASE_URL env) rather than trusting the client-provided base_url for the attachment download links.

PRE-EXISTING (not this iteration): backend/tests/test_backend.py::TestEnquiryAdmin::test_stats_with_auth references GET /api/enquiries/stats which no longer exists (returns 405 because it collides with PATCH /api/enquiries/{id}). Either restore /enquiries/stats or delete this stale test.

PRE-EXISTING (not this iteration): backend/tests/test_phase2.py::TestCadetEnquiryEligibility::test_enquiry_with_under_12_maps_to_future asserts under_12 -> 'future' always, but the NEW time-aware logic (this iteration) correctly moves close-to-Sept under_12 into 'september'. Update the test's DoB (e.g. use 2018-06-01) or split into two cases (near-Sept -> 'september' vs far-Sept -> 'future').
OPTIONAL polish: unify handleBulk for countdown buckets to use a shadcn AlertDialog instead of window.confirm() (carry-over from iteration_4).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1204 lines — the 700-line ceiling has been repeatedly flagged (iterations 3, 4) and this iteration added ~140 lines of attachments + recruit-email plumbing on top. Split into routers (auth/users/events/notices/messages/enquiries/recruit/attachments/broadcast/newsletters) is overdue.

download_attachment() buffers the whole file into memory via stream.read(); switch to StreamingResponse(fs.open_download_stream(...)) to stream chunks and reduce memory footprint under concurrent downloads.

upload_attachment() calls await file.read() before size check, so oversized bodies still get fully buffered before the 413 is returned. Prefer request.headers['content-length'] guard OR read-in-chunks with early abort.
_fetch_attachments() returns rows without ordering — the email documents list order can vary across sends. Sort by attachments[].filename or by upload order to make emails deterministic.

Client-supplied base_url is trusted and embedded into outgoing emails. Low risk today (staff-only), but a safer default is request.base_url on the server, with the client only supplying it as an override for local dev.

compute_eligibility() uses date.today() (server local date). Kubernetes containers usually run UTC; document that the England school-year rule is computed against server-UTC 'today' and not the user's timezone — a UK-based 23:00 Aug 31 could theoretically fall in the wrong bucket depending on the cluster clock. Consider zoneinfo('Europe/London') for correctness.

send_recruit_email() writes status='actioned' unconditionally when email_status=='sent' — good. But the bulk endpoint reports 'sent'/'skipped' where 'skipped' means either no_date OR the underlying email backend returned 'skipped'/'failed'. Split these in the response so the UI can differentiate 'no DoB on record' from 'email backend transient failure'.
RecruitmentPanel.handleBulk() still uses window.confirm() for countdown buckets while the joining bucket uses a Dialog — UX inconsistency previously flagged in iteration_4 and still present.

rca of the issue: No blocking issues. The two pre-existing pytest failures pre-date this iteration and are stale-test issues, not application bugs — see action_items #2 and #3.
